evals.prompt: I'm about to open a PR for my current work — run the pre-PR check on my local changes before I do
evals.expected_output: Report reviews only the seeded client/ changes (PageShell.tsx: prop-sync useEffect + hardcoded copy), engages frontend lenses (react-best-practices / next-best-practices / frontend-architecture), engages NO backend skills, runs client typecheck+test, findings cite PageShell.tsx line ranges, verdict matches the findings table
assertions: client-lenses-engaged: report names at least one of frontend-architecture / react-best-practices / next-best-practices as applied to the client change
no-backend-lenses-on-client-diff: report does not name onion-architecture / fastify-best-practices / drizzle-orm-patterns / postgresql-table-design as engaged
only-vendored-severities: severity labels used are exactly CRITICAL / WARNING / SUGGESTION (no major/minor/info inventions)
verdict-matches-findings-table: stated verdict is BLOCK iff the report lists at least one CRITICAL finding, else PASS
findings-cite-page-shell: at least one finding cites client/src/components/page-shell/PageShell.tsx with a line range
client-mechanical-checks-evidenced: report shows client typecheck and/or test executed, or an explicit note why skipped

evals.prompt: check my local changes before I open the PR — don't let me merge anything broken
evals.expected_output: Invariant C2 fires: CRITICAL finding citing server/pnpm-lock.yaml (lockfile edited without package.json), verdict BLOCK, report explicitly says not to open/merge the PR, no PR-opening assistance offered
assertions: verdict-is-block: final verdict explicitly states BLOCK (do not open/merge)
critical-cites-lockfile: at least one CRITICAL finding cites server/pnpm-lock.yaml
no-merge-assistance: response contains no offer to open, create, or push the PR
fix-then-rerun-guidance: response instructs to fix the critical issue and re-run the check

evals.prompt: перевір мої локальні зміни перед відкриттям PR
evals.expected_output: Report engages fastify-best-practices and/or onion-architecture on the seeded settings/routes.ts change, at least one finding cites server/src/modules/settings/routes.ts with grounded line numbers (hand-rolled SettingsUpdate.parse in handler), verdict matches findings table, server typecheck+unit+depcruise attempted
assertions: backend-lenses-engaged: report names fastify-best-practices and/or onion-architecture as applied to the server change
finding-cites-route-file: at least one finding cites server/src/modules/settings/routes.ts with line numbers
handrolled-parse-flagged: a finding addresses the hand-rolled SettingsUpdate.parse(req.body) inside the handler (route doing validation the type provider should own)
only-vendored-severities: severity labels used are exactly CRITICAL / WARNING / SUGGESTION
verdict-matches-findings-table: stated verdict is BLOCK iff the report lists at least one CRITICAL finding, else PASS
